GENERAL_METADATA.item: Title block is fully completed (Part Name, Dwg No, Scale, Units).
Projection method indicator (1st or 3rd angle) is explicitly shown.
Standard linear and angular tolerance block is defined and filled.
Material specification and surface finish requirements are stated.

VIEW_INTEGRITY.item: Sufficient views are provided to completely define the part geometry.
Section views have correct cutting plane lines and matching hatch patterns.
Hidden lines are correctly formatted and consistently used where necessary.
Centerlines and center marks are applied to all symmetrical and cylindrical features.

DIMENSIONING_RULES.item: No duplicate or redundant dimensions are present (no double dimensioning).
All dimensions match the active scale and are not hard-coded/overridden overrides.
Extension lines do not directly cross dimension lines where avoidable.
Cylindrical features use the diameter symbol (Ø) preceding the value.
Spherical or radius features use proper prefix symbols (SØ, R, SR).

GDT_AND_TOLERANCING.item: Feature Control Frames (FCFs) are syntactically valid and properly attached.
Datum Feature Symbols are correctly labeled and referenced in the FCF.
Basic dimensions (boxed) are used for all positional and profile tolerancing.
Material condition modifiers (MMC/LMC) are applied only to features of size.
Surface texture symbols indicate required roughness values (Ra).

MANUFACTURABILITY.item: Standard thread callouts specify pitch/class correctly (e.g., M10x1.5 or 3/8-16 UNC).
Clear notes define default edge breaks (e.g., REMOVE ALL BURRS / SHARP EDGES).
